entities.summary: Adolfo Daniel Vallejo is a Paraguayan professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of No. 99 achieved on 16 March 2026 and a doubles ranking of No. 435 reached on 21 April 2025. He is currently the No. 1 singles player from Paraguay.
